name: GPU Ray-tracing of SSVDAG
definition: A GPU-based raytracer traversal method for SSVDAG that adapts octree traversal to handle variable-rate encoded child pointers and apply symmetry transformations upon entering subtrees.
summary: GPU Ray-tracing of SSVDAG is a traversal method that handles variable-rate encoded child pointers and applies symmetry transformations to enable efficient visibility queries on compressed data.
